worldGenerate.label: World Tour
worldGenerate.summary: Generate immersive 3D worlds and explore their saved scenes.

WorldTour.launchTokenRequired: World-tour viewer requires a standalone app launch token.
WorldTour.noPreset: No viewpoint has been saved for this world yet.
WorldTour.controlHelp: Drag to look · W A S D to move · Q / E down / up · Shift to move faster. Click the scene to use keyboard controls.
WorldTour.promptRequired: Describe the world you want to explore.
WorldTour.generating: Generating the world and saving its assets. This may take a few minutes…
WorldTour.archiveMissing: The completed job did not return a world archive.
WorldTour.generated: World saved. The 3D viewer is open.
WorldTour.savedOpenFailed: World saved, but the viewer could not open. Use Open saved world to try again.
WorldTour.historyUnavailable: This saved world could not be opened. Its archive must still match this history record.
WorldTour.noPendingWorld: There is no unfinished world generation to continue.
WorldTour.pendingInvalid: The saved world task reference is invalid.
WorldTour.pendingExists: A world task is already submitted. Use Continue last generation in Parameters to retrieve its result.
WorldTour.noSavedWorld: Generate a world first. It will be saved here for your next visit.
WorldTour.sourceUnavailable: The source is missing or changed and cannot be previewed or reused.
WorldTour.sourceRequired: Choose one source image. Text may be left empty.
WorldTour.imageLimits: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 20 MB and 16 MP. Normalize image orientation to upright first.
WorldTour.panoLimits: Choose an upright, full 360°×180° equirectangular panorama with exactly 2:1 dimensions. The ratio alone does not establish panorama content. Up to 20 MB and 16 MP.
WorldTour.originalInputUnknown: This record has no complete original request snapshot. Its input is unknown; the saved world can still be opened.
WorldTour.submissionUnknown: The Submit receipt is missing and no Job ID is known. The original request is retained; generation cannot be retried automatically.
WorldTour.archiveInvalid: The saved archive does not match this Job.
WorldTour.walkUnavailable: No verified safe walking position fits this body. Choose flying or adjust its size.
WorldTour.bodySizeInvalid: Invalid body dimensions or geometry not ready. Height 0.5–2.4 m, radius 0.1–0.4 m; height must exceed diameter.
WorldTour.noSafeSpawn: This geometry has no verified ground and clearance for the selected body. Walking is unavailable; adjust body size or explicitly choose flying. World metadata scale is preserved.
WorldTour.colliderUnavailable: The archive has no usable collision geometry. Walking is unavailable; explicitly choose flying.
WorldTour.unsafePreset: This viewpoint belongs to another archive or is unsafe for the current walking mode/body. Legacy viewpoints may be restored after explicitly selecting flight.
WorldTour.walkHelp: Drag to look · W A S D to walk along the ground · Shift to speed up. Walls and unsupported edges block movement. Click the scene for keyboard control. Entering walk mode or resetting returns to a verified starting point.
WorldTour.objectImportHelp: Self-contained static GLB 2.0, up to 16 MiB. No external files, compression, skins or animations.
WorldTour.objectsEmpty: Import an object to place it in this world.
WorldTour.objectDragHelp: Drag the selected object’s handles, or enter its transform below.
WorldTour.objectCollisionHelp: Imported objects are static decoration. They do not affect walking collisions or provide dynamic physics. Dimensions follow the GLB’s authored units; adjust scale as needed.
WorldTour.sceneUnsavedHelp: Closing the viewer or loading the saved scene discards unsaved edits. Removing an instance keeps its file available for other instances and scenes.
WorldTour.objectLimits: Limit exceeded. Each object supports up to 16 MiB, 250,000 vertices, 500,000 triangles up to 8 textures of 2048px, and 32 MiB of decoded textures. Each scene supports 16 instances, 8 assets, 1,000,000 vertices, 2,000,000 triangles and 128 MiB of decoded textures. Use a smaller GLB or remove instances before importing again.
WorldTour.objectExternal: This GLB references external resources. Export a self-contained GLB before importing.
WorldTour.objectUnsupported: Unsupported model content. Export one static scene with ordinary triangle meshes and embedded PNG/JPEG textures, without compression, skins, morphs or animations.
WorldTour.objectInvalid: The GLB could not be loaded. Check the file and try another self-contained static GLB. Existing objects are unchanged.
WorldTour.objectMissing: A referenced object file is missing, changed or unreadable. Existing objects are unchanged. Restore its original asset before reloading.
WorldTour.sceneInvalid: The saved scene is invalid or belongs to a different archive. It has not replaced this scene.
WorldTour.sceneConflict: The saved scene changed in another window. Load it again before saving your edits.
WorldTour.sceneSaveFailed: Save could not be confirmed. Your edits remain here; check storage and reload before trying again.
WorldTour.objectTransformInvalid: Use finite positions within ±1000 m, rotations within ±36000°, and scale from 0.01 to 100 on every axis.

worldGenerate.inputPlaceholder: A place, its architecture, lighting, and atmosphere…
worldGenerate.inputNote: Generate an immersive 3D scene from your description.
worldGenerate.emptyHint: Describe a scene and generate a world. The viewer opens when its assets are saved.
worldGenerate.footnote: Generation may take a few minutes. Saved worlds can be reopened without generating them again.
